epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dragon finds out that learning a new language is like a secret password into another world./ When Shimmer’s friend, Cookie, loses her butterfly instincts, Miss Spider and her bug clan must help her regain them before winter arrives in Sunny Patch.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女王去度假,留給國王很多職務。他立即採取行動,找其他人來做。莉塔肯幫助國王……如果她能成為啫堡的女王!起初,所有孩子都很高興自己有份負責。不過,很快樂趣和遊戲就被只有莉塔開心的遊戲所取代。小女王必須意識到這種權力是如何沖昏她的頭腦。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen goes on vacation, leaving King with lots of responsibilities. He leaps into action, finding someone else to do it. Rita will help the King...if she’s made Queen of Jammbo! At first, all the kids are happy one of their own is in charge. But,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們圍坐在篝火旁講恐怖故事。姑毛講述了最可怕的怪物故事,然後去吃點心。不過,他走得太遠!其他人必須在黑暗的樹林裡尋找他!神秘的影子和聲音很快讓他們都以為有怪物在跟蹤他們!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The kids are sitting around a campfire telling scary stories. Goomo tells the scariest monster story and then goes off to get a snack. But, he’s gone too long! The others must look for him in the dark woods! Before long mysterious shadow and sounds h

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫喱星頌揚音樂、樂趣和友誼。加入貝洛和他的朋友們的喜劇冒險之旅,學習在神奇的詹博星球(宇宙音樂的起源)上和諧相處。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello makes a mistake and decides to make up a story, which is hard to believe. Mina gets angry and will put him to the test: the Candy of Truth. A sweet that makes you float every time you lie. Bello accepts the challenge and a spiral of lies and da

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜嘗試打造啫堡史上最驚人的韆鞦來取悅國王。不幸的是,這位年輕的科學家很快就發現,無論多麼先進的技術,都無法取締團隊合作和友誼。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina tries to please the King by building the most amazing swing in the history of Jammbo. Unfortunately, the young scientist will soon discover that no matter how advanced technology is, it will never substitute teamwork and friendship.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路被委派一項非常重要的工作—負責管理音樂工廠!儘管女王留下了說明書,比路卻無視它。她一去休息,整個運作就變得瘋狂。可憐的渡渡鳥努力把事情做好,但欠缺知情的老闆,災難迫在眉睫。比路必須快速學習,準備工作是正確執行任何工作的關鍵!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is given a very important job---he’s put in charge of running the Music Factory! Though the Queen leaves the instruction manual, Bello ignores it. As soon as she goes off for a much needed rest, the whole operation goes way crazy. The poor dodo

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔厭倦了她玩的每場比賽都輸掉,所以她用一些小氣的手鐲來助她必勝。儘管一開始她很開心,但卻發現自己掉進一個危險的陷阱,並將使她成為一個失敗者。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita is tired of losing at every game she plays so she allies herself with some stingy bracelets that will help her win at absolutely everything. Even though she is happy at first, Rita discovers that she’s fallen into a dangerous trap, which will ma

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡有麻煩了!它那奇妙的音樂泡泡充滿了垃圾和黏糊糊的東西。經過調查整個星球,國王、王后和孩子們意識到泡泡裡的垃圾正是他們的垃圾!他們齊心協力改變邋遢的習慣,讓啫堡恢復啫喱般的健康。他們在過程中將垃圾回收成大家都能享用的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jammbo’s in trouble! Its amazing music bubbles are full of trash and gunky goo. After a planet wide investigation, the King, Queen and kids realize that the junk in the bubbles is their own garbage! They work together to change their sloppy habits an

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多得一些突破性的科學,米娜能夠讓物體和她自己隱形!她看到隱形對她信任的朋友的影響!經過一天的瘋狂事件後,孩子們發現了所有看不見的怪事的罪魁禍首。他們想出一個自己的實驗,看看科學家有多喜歡接受測試!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thanks to some breakthrough science, Mina is able to make objects, and herself, invisible! She can’t help but see the effects of invisibility on her unsuspecting friends! After a day of wild happenings the kids discover the culprit of all the invisib

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啫堡從未經歷過最驚人的事件之一即將發生。姑毛不想錯過它。這就是為何他嘗試向他的朋友隱瞞他的啫喱疹。不幸的是,啫喱疹有無法掩飾的症狀。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the most amazing events that Jammbo has ever experienced is about to occur. And Goomo doesn’t want tomiss it. That’s why he tries to hide his Jelly-Measles from his friends. Unfortunately, the measles have symptoms that are impossible to disgu

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 受到閃電和雷聲的驚嚇,比路和姑毛在音樂工廠尋求庇護。不過進去以後,他們才意識到將迎接更可怕的事;城堡裡有個幽靈嚇壞了渡渡鳥,阻止牠們製造音樂泡泡!如果渡渡鳥停下來,啫堡就沒有音樂。而如果沒有音樂,啫喱星就會凍結!哎呀!男孩們需要找到幽靈,擊潰它並拯救永遠充滿音樂氣息的啫堡!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spooked by lighting and thunder, Bello and Goomo seek refuge in the Music Factory. But once inside, they realize there’s much scarier stuff afoot; there’s a ghost in the castle that’s frightening the dodos and keeping them from making music bubbles!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王不想與人分享他的新火箭驅動滑板,所以把它藏在一個魔法盒子裡。姑毛和比路決定取得它,挑戰國王的意願,最終進入一個更大的新世界。一個充滿樂趣和……危險的世界。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King doesn’t want to share his new rocket powered skateboard so he hides it in a magic box. Goomo and Bello decide to claim it, challenging the King’s wishes, and end up in a new and larger world. A world of fun and….danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇后心情不好。國王和孩子們同意舉辦有史以來最好的生日派對。不幸的是,每個參與者對於如何組織女王的驚喜派對都有個別非常特別的想法。它的成功將取決於他們「易地而處」的能力。尤其是女王。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Queen feels gloomy. The King and the children agree to organize the best birthday party ever. Unfortunately each of the participants has a very particular idea as to how to organize the Queen’s surprise party. Its success will depend on their cap

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路厭倦了女王,他認為女王試圖毀掉他所有的冒險和遊戲。在滿天流星的星夜,比路許下一個願望:願女王變回少女,讓他為所欲為。當比路的願望成真,他將必須當個瘋狂的小女王哥哥,並意識到這可能是很艱鉅的任務,有時甚至很危險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is fed up with the Queen, whom he thinks tries to ruin all his adventures and games. On a starry night, full of shooting stars, Bello makes a wish: may the Queen become a young girl again so she can let him do anything he wants. When Bello’s wi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是姑毛的生日,他有很高期望。不幸的是,他醒來發現珍愛的頭盔不見了!最重要的是,他的朋友們表現得很奇怪,他們似乎都忘記了他的生日。姑毛很樂意讓一切恢復正常。幸運的是,他收到一個驚喜,可以讓這天成為一個非常特別的日子。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its Goomos birthday and his hopes are high. Unfortunately, he wakes to find his precious helmet missing! On top of that his friends are acting strangely and they all appear to have forgotten all about his birthday. Goomo would be happy to have thin

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安高在與比路和姑毛玩耍時弄傷了自己,因此必須在家休息幾天。比路感到內疚,決定搬進安高的房子,直到他的朋友好轉為止。他們對生活的不同看法相交,然後一起發現如果睜大眼睛看一切,即使是最小的細節,也可以很享受。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ongo hurt himself while playing with Bello and Goomo so he must stay at home to rest for several days. Bello feels guilty and decides to move into Ongo’s house until his friend feels better. Their different views on life will meet and together they’l

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔在米娜的實驗室試做自己的實驗。她很快就發現首先需要學習一些基礎知識來避免災難發生。

epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #14
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠在森林裡發現了一隻沒有鹿角的小鹿。出於安全考量,遊俠嘗試保護牠不受傷害。不過,他們很快就發現牠還有其他手段自保。留意觀看它們到底是甚麼!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers spot a small dear in the forest without any antlers.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #15
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #15
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利發現一隻小鳥被困樹上,而牠的同伴卻不見蹤影。少年遊俠兵分兩路執行任務:一組留下來從掠食者手中保護樹上的小鳥,另一組則去搜救失蹤同伴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zari discovers a bird trapped in a tree and its partner is nowhere to be found.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #16
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #16
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠遇到一種可以在逃避掠食者時將尾巴與身體分離的動物。但他們必須從肥皂災難中把牠拯救出來免牠受傷。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers come across an animal that can separate its tail from its body to escape predators.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #17
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #17
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠發現一隻可愛的海洋動物嬰兒在海中游蕩。要讓牠與母親團聚實在很有挑戰性,尤其嬰兒不斷因其他動物和隨機物件而分心。他們能成功嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers find a cute baby sea animal wandering the ocean.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #18
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #18
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年遊俠的任務是讓黃蜂遠離蜂巢。姬蒂有一個新設備可以提供幫助……前題是她能使它正常運作。他們能成功完成任務嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers are on a mission to keep hornets away from a beehive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水花帶牠的朋友去看探望朋友阿Lu/ 章魚浪花喜歡礁鎮的樂韻。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Splash takes his pals to go see his friend, LU / Wave, the octopus, loves the musicality of Reeftown.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水花被一條牠想交朋友的魚忽視/ 七彩麒麟芬尼加入一起玩。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Splash is ignored by a fish he wants to make friends with / Finny, a green dragonet, joins the group to play.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水花、寶泡和阿燈遇到自封為森林遊俠的奇普/ 寶泡的鰭受傷並無法游泳。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Splash, Bubbles, and Dunk meet a self-appointed Kelp Forest Ranger / Bubbles injures her fin and has trouble swimming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿燈的朋友發現他製作美麗的沙畫/ 阿波帶領同伴調查海龍的傳說。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dunks friends discover he makes beautiful sand art / Ripple leads the gang to investigate the legend of the Sea Dragon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《小毛孩動腦筋》考驗你的動物知識- 一個獨一無二的遊戲節目!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Test your animal knowledge on ZooMoos Got Brains -- A game show like no other!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Test your animal knowledge on ZooMoos Got Brains -- A game show like no other!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Test your animal knowledge on ZooMoos Got Brains -- A game show like no other!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於動物的晚餐吃甚麼的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about what animals eat for dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於蛋的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於動物腳部的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animal legs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ZooMoo小隊進行一場關於有翅動物的問答遊戲。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about winged wonders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路發現他最好的朋友有音樂天賦。從那一刻起,他將嘗試與其他朋友分享發現。儘管姑毛很害羞,比路還是會嘗試揭露和分享這個秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛弄丟了他用來和比路玩啫堡俠和頭盔仔的眼鏡。他們都發現一隻戴著姑毛眼鏡的瞎子渡渡鳥。戴上它後,渡渡鳥可以重見光明,並與其他渡渡鳥玩耍。姑毛會放棄他的眼鏡,還是取回它去當超級英雄?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has lost the glasses he uses to play Jammboman and Helmetkid with Bello. Both friends discover a blind Dodo wearing Goomo’s glasses. With them on, the Dodo can actually see and play with the rest of the Dodos. Will Goomo give up his glasses or

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和公主正在舉行一場可愛的粉紅色野餐:粉紅色的菜餚、粉紅色的食物、粉紅色的一切!莉塔向公主傾訴她希望啫堡上的所有東西都是她最喜歡的顏色。她衝到音樂工廠,將五顏六色的音樂泡泡變成粉紅色,這可能會讓一切變得一樣!當其他孩子意識到莉塔的行動時,他們必須在啫堡變成一片大而無聊、貧瘠的粉紅色荒地前,努力恢復
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored mus

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛和莉塔正在戶外度過愉快的一天,突然發現一顆渡渡鳥蛋。孩子們和小雞蛋將進行動作連場的冒險。經過這麼多的喧囂,鳥蛋能存活下來嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 音盤已經瘋了,啫堡中的所有聲音都被改變,造成了巨大的混亂。比路和莉塔將負責將每一個聲音歸還到它所屬的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路必須戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮喪。幸運的是,他的朋友們用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何問題都可以變成有趣的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello has to wear an eye patch. He feels uncomfortable and discouraged because of how he looks. Luckily, his friends use the wisdom of a song to remind him that any problem can turn into something fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛決定穿上一雙神奇的運動鞋走10萬步,這將帶他找到一個神奇的寶藏。至少他堅信如此,而他的朋友們則認為他瘋了。最後,誰會贏?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has decided to take 100.000 steps with a pair of magic sneakers that will lead him to an amazing treasure. At least that’s what he believes because his friends think he’s gone crazy. In the end, who wins?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工需要甚麼?我們可以用日常物品創造出哪些驚人的發明?米娜有答案。她很快就會向她的朋友們證明科學不一定無聊。事實上,那可能是秘密特工的最佳資源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does a special agent need? What amazing inventions can we create with our everyday objects? Mina has the answer. She´ll soon prove to her friends that science doesnt need to be boring. In fact it can be a secret agents´ best resource.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們參加捉伊人比賽,看誰是宇宙中最強隊伍。那麼,這有甚麼問題呢?即使他們不在比賽時,也開始將其他隊員視為敵人。必須有人教他們競爭和敵對的分別。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get wound up in a tag-playing competition to see who the best team in the universe is. So, what´s wrong with that? They begin to see the other team members as enemies even when they´re not playing. Someone will have to teach them the dif

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王迫不及待地想試用他的新品:一個會隨著音樂飛舞的浴缸。當國王暫時離開時,比路和米娜最終成為第一個嘗試的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King is impatient to try out his new acquisition: a bathtub that flies to music. When the King steps away momentarily, Bello and Mina end up being the first to try it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路突然擁有了強大的力量,這要歸功於一枚滿足他所有願望的警長星章。他的新責任賦予了他如此多的力量,令比路最終希望得到很快就會後悔的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello suddenly has great powers thanks to a sheriff star badge that grants his every wish. His new responsibility empowers him so much that Bello ends up wishing for something he´ll soon regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王傷了背部。每個人都想出一個計劃,把他安然無恙地送回城堡裡舒適的床上。他們必須學會傾聽對方的意見,甚至考慮最荒謬的選擇,因為你永遠不知道答案在哪裡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has hurt his back. Everyone thinks of a plan to transport him –safe and sound – to his comfortable bed back in the castle. They must learn to listen to each other and consider even the most absurd options because you never know where the ans

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛必須擔任舞蹈比賽的評委。起初,這個決定似乎很容易,但當他發現選擇贏家就意味著選擇輸家時……事情變得複雜!他會失去他淘汰的朋友嗎?那樣重的責任會令他感覺怎樣?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has to judge a dance contest. At first, the decision seems easy but when he discovers that choosing a winner means choosing a loser... It gets complicated! Will he lose the friend he signals out as the loser? How does so much responsibility mak

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是孩子們相聚並畫畫的好日子,他們都興奮地開始。比路知道他的畫是女王的最愛,他迫不及待地想給她看他最新的作品。不幸的是,女王正忙著教莉塔一些東西。比路認為這不公平。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a wonderful day to draw and the children gather round, exited to get started. Bello knows his drawings are the Queens favorite and he cant wait to show her his latest one. Unfortunately, the Queen is too busy trying to teach Rita something. Be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白色渡渡鳥突然造訪孩子們。他們所有人,尤其是安高,都與這種不可思議的動物交上了朋友。不幸的是,白色渡渡鳥有一個任務在身,分別似乎無可避免。儘管悲傷地告別,但總有音樂讓他們振作起來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get a surprise visit from a White Dodo. All of them, especially Ongo, make friends with this incredible animal. Unfortunately, the White Dodo has a mission to accomplish and a separation seems inevitable. Despite the sad goodbye, there i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜讀完智者伊朵羅的傳記後,驚訝萬分。對她來說,沒有甚麼比智慧更重要。這就是為何她會避免發問,以免暴露她的無知。令她吃驚的是,有些事情其他人都知道,除了她自己。很快她就會明白不恥下問的重要性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina is in awe after reading Yidoro The Wises biography. For her, there is nothing more important than wisdom.Thats why she will avoid asking questions that would reveal her ignorance. To her surprise there are things that everyone else knows, exce

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #5
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎土豚和變色龍來到節目。牠們都有長舌,用於進食、打理和防衛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome an Aardvark and Chameleon to the show. These animals both have very long tongues that are used for eating, grooming and protection.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #6
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎大象和獵犬來到節目。牠們都努力保持涼爽!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome an Elephant and a Hunting Dog to the show. Each of these animals works hard to stay cool!

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #7
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎斑馬和獅子來到節目。牠們有共同的棲息地:非洲草原。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Zebra and a Lion to the show. These animals share a habitat: the African Grasslands.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #8
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎響尾蛇和超特殊客人史汀奇自己!牠們都因其防禦機制而在整個動物界享負盛名。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Rattlesnake and extra special guest Stinky! Both animals are known throughout the animal kingdom for their defense mechanisms.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一些球員開始發脾氣,一場椰子沙灘足球比賽變得緊張起來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A game of coconut beach soccer becomes stressful when some of the players start throwing tantrums.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利希望他有寶拉和阿添那樣的表兄弟姊妹。小孩們幫尋找他的表兄弟姊妹。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy wishes he had cousins like Paula and Tim has. The children help to find his cousins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比利設法說服寶拉和其他人將探險家先生從尷尬的困境中解救出來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Billy manages to convince Paula and the others to save Mr Explorer from a sticky situation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅鬍子船長摧毀了小孩們的沙堡。如何應對像紅鬍子這樣的惡霸呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Redbeard destroys the childrens sandcastles. How to deal with a bully like Redbeard?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場誤會惹怒了紅鬍子船長,他做了一些刻薄的事來報復小孩們。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A misunderstanding angers Captain Redbeard and he does something mean to get back at the children.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅鬍子船長不斷對莫里斯頤指氣使。他甚至命令莫里斯要快樂。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Redbeard is constantly ordering Maurice around. He even orders Maurice to be happy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探險家先生俘虜了圖騰頭先生!寶拉和她的朋友們將如何拯救圖騰頭先生?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mr. Explorer has captured Mr Totemhead! What will Paula and her friends do to save Mr Totemhead?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小孩們去叢林探險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children go for an adventure through the Jungle.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #19
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #19
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這裡有松鼠,那裡有松鼠,到處都有松鼠!少年遊俠必須阻止松鼠入侵薩利鄰近的社區花園。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers must stop a squirrel invasion at Zari’s neighbourhood community garden.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #20
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #20
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 里奧和姬蒂把他們的小工具借給薩利,但卻被一群頑皮的猴子截劫。在沒有任何小工具幫助他們完成任務的情況下,遊俠將如何奪回他們的小工具呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leo and Katie loan out their gadgets to Zari, but they get stolen by a bunch of mischievous monkeys.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠薩利意外地在膠杯中發現了一隻獨特的昆蟲,他呼召遊俠團協助這隻可憐的生物安全回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Zari calls for the Rangers in helping a unique insect get back to safety.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉偶然發現一雙被困在井裡的母獅和她的幼獅。在遊俠的幫助下,他們需要想方設法來幫牠們擺脫困境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farah stumbles upon a trapped lioness and her cub inside a well.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉發現一顆未知的動物牙齒,並尋求遊俠團協助將其歸還給真正的主人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farah finds an unknown animal tooth and seeks the Rangers assistance in returning it to its rightful owner.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪遇到一隻正在掙扎的被困海豚!他尋求少年遊俠團協助海豚重獲自由。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kyle comes across a struggling trapped dolphin!

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利和法拉築篝火過夜時偶遇一隻馬來亞幼虎,於是呼召少年遊俠團助牠與母親團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stumbling a Malayan Tiger cub during their campfire sleepover.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱憐憫受傷的螃蟹,他呼召少年遊俠團幫助這隻可憐的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai calls for the Junior Rangers in helping the injured crab.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場意外令凱的無人機墜入海床。他知道一頭不知名的怪物劫持了那墜落的無人機後,就呼召少年遊俠團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai calls up the Junior Ranger as he learns a obscure monster is taken his fallen drone as hostage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利發現一隻可能瀕臨絕種的黃胸織布鳥,這讓少年遊俠團們警戒起來,迅速動員採取行動,決心保護這鳥類免受傷害。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers determined to safeguard the Baya Weaver bird from harm.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #9
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪並不知道與斧頭鯊共泳有多險象橫生,少年遊俠團隊用新升級的車輛極速去營救嘉豪。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers rush their way to rescue Kyle from hammerhead sharks with their newly upgraded vehicle.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about what animals eat for dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about animal legs.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMoo teams compete in a quiz show about winged wonders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小麻、盤絲和雪兒跟一隻獨立的小亞洲瓢蟲成為朋友,發現她的獨立是有原因的:她的家人在冬眠後飛走了,卻不小心把她獨留下來。/秋天到了,迷路的小瓢蟲季絲確信家人會回到陽光派。但事與願違,史汀奇和韋飛建議收留她- 直至她不需要為止。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Shimmer, Pansy and Snowdrop befriend an independent little Asian ladybug it turns out she is independent for a reason./ It’s fall and Grace, the little lost ladybug, is sure her family is coming back to Sunny Patch.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路發現他最好的朋友有音樂天賦。從那一刻起,他將嘗試與其他朋友分享發現。儘管姑毛很害羞,比路還是會嘗試揭露和分享這個秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛弄丟了他用來和比路玩啫堡俠和頭盔仔的眼鏡。他們都發現一隻戴著姑毛眼鏡的瞎子渡渡鳥。戴上它後,渡渡鳥可以重見光明,並與其他渡渡鳥玩耍。姑毛會放棄他的眼鏡,還是取回它去當超級英雄?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has lost the glasses he uses to play Jammboman and Helmetkid with Bello. Both friends discover a blind Dodo wearing Goomo’s glasses. With them on, the Dodo can actually see and play with the rest of the Dodos. Will Goomo give up his glasses or

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔和公主正在舉行一場可愛的粉紅色野餐:粉紅色的菜餚、粉紅色的食物、粉紅色的一切!莉塔向公主傾訴她希望啫堡上的所有東西都是她最喜歡的顏色。她衝到音樂工廠,將五顏六色的音樂泡泡變成粉紅色,這可能會讓一切變得一樣!當其他孩子意識到莉塔的行動時,他們必須在啫堡變成一片大而無聊、貧瘠的粉紅色荒地前,努力恢復
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored mus

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛和莉塔正在戶外度過愉快的一天,突然發現一顆渡渡鳥蛋。孩子們和小雞蛋將進行動作連場的冒險。經過這麼多的喧囂,鳥蛋能存活下來嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 音盤已經瘋了,啫堡中的所有聲音都被改變,造成了巨大的混亂。比路和莉塔將負責將每一個聲音歸還到它所屬的地方。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路必須戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮喪。幸運的是,他的朋友們用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何問題都可以變成有趣的事情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello has to wear an eye patch. He feels uncomfortable and discouraged because of how he looks. Luckily, his friends use the wisdom of a song to remind him that any problem can turn into something fun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛決定穿上一雙神奇的運動鞋走10萬步,這將帶他找到一個神奇的寶藏。至少他堅信如此,而他的朋友們則認為他瘋了。最後,誰會贏?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has decided to take 100.000 steps with a pair of magic sneakers that will lead him to an amazing treasure. At least that’s what he believes because his friends think he’s gone crazy. In the end, who wins?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工需要甚麼?我們可以用日常物品創造出哪些驚人的發明?米娜有答案。她很快就會向她的朋友們證明科學不一定無聊。事實上,那可能是秘密特工的最佳資源。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does a special agent need? What amazing inventions can we create with our everyday objects? Mina has the answer. She´ll soon prove to her friends that science doesnt need to be boring. In fact it can be a secret agents´ best resource.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們參加捉伊人比賽,看誰是宇宙中最強隊伍。那麼,這有甚麼問題呢?即使他們不在比賽時,也開始將其他隊員視為敵人。必須有人教他們競爭和敵對的分別。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get wound up in a tag-playing competition to see who the best team in the universe is. So, what´s wrong with that? They begin to see the other team members as enemies even when they´re not playing. Someone will have to teach them the dif

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王迫不及待地想試用他的新品:一個會隨著音樂飛舞的浴缸。當國王暫時離開時,比路和米娜最終成為第一個嘗試的人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King is impatient to try out his new acquisition: a bathtub that flies to music. When the King steps away momentarily, Bello and Mina end up being the first to try it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路突然擁有了強大的力量,這要歸功於一枚滿足他所有願望的警長星章。他的新責任賦予了他如此多的力量,令比路最終希望得到很快就會後悔的東西。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello suddenly has great powers thanks to a sheriff star badge that grants his every wish. His new responsibility empowers him so much that Bello ends up wishing for something he´ll soon regret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王傷了背部。每個人都想出一個計劃,把他安然無恙地送回城堡裡舒適的床上。他們必須學會傾聽對方的意見,甚至考慮最荒謬的選擇,因為你永遠不知道答案在哪裡。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King has hurt his back. Everyone thinks of a plan to transport him –safe and sound – to his comfortable bed back in the castle. They must learn to listen to each other and consider even the most absurd options because you never know where the ans

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姑毛必須擔任舞蹈比賽的評委。起初,這個決定似乎很容易,但當他發現選擇贏家就意味著選擇輸家時……事情變得複雜!他會失去他淘汰的朋友嗎?那樣重的責任會令他感覺怎樣?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Goomo has to judge a dance contest. At first, the decision seems easy but when he discovers that choosing a winner means choosing a loser... It gets complicated! Will he lose the friend he signals out as the loser? How does so much responsibility mak

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今天是孩子們相聚並畫畫的好日子,他們都興奮地開始。比路知道他的畫是女王的最愛,他迫不及待地想給她看他最新的作品。不幸的是,女王正忙著教莉塔一些東西。比路認為這不公平。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a wonderful day to draw and the children gather round, exited to get started. Bello knows his drawings are the Queens favorite and he cant wait to show her his latest one. Unfortunately, the Queen is too busy trying to teach Rita something. Be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白色渡渡鳥突然造訪孩子們。他們所有人,尤其是安高,都與這種不可思議的動物交上了朋友。不幸的是,白色渡渡鳥有一個任務在身,分別似乎無可避免。儘管悲傷地告別,但總有音樂讓他們振作起來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children get a surprise visit from a White Dodo. All of them, especially Ongo, make friends with this incredible animal. Unfortunately, the White Dodo has a mission to accomplish and a separation seems inevitable. Despite the sad goodbye, there i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米娜讀完智者伊朵羅的傳記後,驚訝萬分。對她來說,沒有甚麼比智慧更重要。這就是為何她會避免發問,以免暴露她的無知。令她吃驚的是,有些事情其他人都知道,除了她自己。很快她就會明白不恥下問的重要性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mina is in awe after reading Yidoro The Wises biography. For her, there is nothing more important than wisdom.Thats why she will avoid asking questions that would reveal her ignorance. To her surprise there are things that everyone else knows, exce

epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #19
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這裡有松鼠,那裡有松鼠,到處都有松鼠!少年遊俠必須阻止松鼠入侵薩利鄰近的社區花園。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers must stop a squirrel invasion at Zari’s neighbourhood community garden.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧新加坡外傳 第2季 #20
epg.programme_title_en: Leo The Wildlife Ranger: Singapore Edition S2 #20
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 里奧和姬蒂把他們的小工具借給薩利,但卻被一群頑皮的猴子截劫。在沒有任何小工具幫助他們完成任務的情況下,遊俠將如何奪回他們的小工具呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leo and Katie loan out their gadgets to Zari, but they get stolen by a bunch of mischievous monkeys.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠薩利意外地在膠杯中發現了一隻獨特的昆蟲,他呼召遊俠團協助這隻可憐的生物安全回家。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ranger Zari calls for the Rangers in helping a unique insect get back to safety.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉偶然發現一雙被困在井裡的母獅和她的幼獅。在遊俠的幫助下,他們需要想方設法來幫牠們擺脫困境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farah stumbles upon a trapped lioness and her cub inside a well.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法拉發現一顆未知的動物牙齒,並尋求遊俠團協助將其歸還給真正的主人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Farah finds an unknown animal tooth and seeks the Rangers assistance in returning it to its rightful owner.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 嘉豪遇到一隻正在掙扎的被困海豚!他尋求少年遊俠團協助海豚重獲自由。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kyle comes across a struggling trapped dolphin!

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利和法拉築篝火過夜時偶遇一隻馬來亞幼虎,於是呼召少年遊俠團助牠與母親團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stumbling a Malayan Tiger cub during their campfire sleepover.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱憐憫受傷的螃蟹,他呼召少年遊俠團幫助這隻可憐的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai calls for the Junior Rangers in helping the injured crab.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場意外令凱的無人機墜入海床。他知道一頭不知名的怪物劫持了那墜落的無人機後,就呼召少年遊俠團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kai calls up the Junior Ranger as he learns a obscure monster is taken his fallen drone as hostage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 薩利發現一隻可能瀕臨絕種的黃胸織布鳥,這讓少年遊俠團們警戒起來,迅速動員採取行動,決心保護這鳥類免受傷害。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Junior Rangers determined to safeguard the Baya Weaver bird from harm.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #9

epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎土豚和變色龍來到節目。牠們都有長舌,用於進食、打理和防衛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome an Aardvark and Chameleon to the show. These animals both have very long tongues that are used for eating, grooming and protection.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #6
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎大象和獵犬來到節目。牠們都努力保持涼爽!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome an Elephant and a Hunting Dog to the show. Each of these animals works hard to stay cool!

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #7
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎斑馬和獅子來到節目。牠們有共同的棲息地:非洲草原。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Zebra and a Lion to the show. These animals share a habitat: the African Grasslands.

epg.programme_title_tc: 史汀奇與積克的動物秀 #8
epg.programme_title_en: Animal Show With Stinky And Jake #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 史汀奇和積克歡迎響尾蛇和超特殊客人史汀奇自己!牠們都因其防禦機制而在整個動物界享負盛名。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stinky and Jake welcome a Rattlesnake and extra special guest Stinky! Both animals are known throughout the animal kingdom for their defense mechanisms.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱的無人機測試發現了一個大熊貓的爪印,促使少年遊俠團開展研究熊貓及其小寶寶的任務。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: While investigating a series of cult ritual massacres, Philippine police rescue the sole survivor on Bohol Island, who is a former FBI agent living under a false identity. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Olivia是位出色的吸血鬼言情小說作家,一直渴望遇到真正的吸血鬼。當吸血鬼Luke出現在Olivia位於雪地的偏僻小屋向她求助時,她的夢想終於成真。然而,當Luke的吸血鬼同伴在平安夜那天追捕他時,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Olivia, an outstanding vampire romance novelist, longs to encounter a real vampire. Her wish comes true when Luke turns up at her remote snowbound cabin seeking for help. However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Lukes vampire companions track him down...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩個立志成為網紅的男生連同一位漂亮女同學,合力在學校後面的舊大樓拍一部靈異實錄片,希望能吸引更多關注。三人遇上校內霸淩同學的富二代男女。原來女同學早已有計劃接近這幾個學校霸淩,籍此展開一場不惜犧牲無辜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A school girl joins two internet content creators in a horror video project filmed in an old building behind their school. The trio encounters a bullying gang and as events unfold, it becomes clear that the girl holds a personal grudge against the gang and is blinded by hatred to exercise justice, even if it means sacrificing the innocents…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失憶青年馬可醒來時,驚覺自己被囚禁在一棟廢棄舊屋,四周屍橫遍地。在密閉空間內,他被迫按照神秘幕後黑手的指示,逐一播放隨身碟中的十段詭異錄像。隨著致命詛咒接連降臨,他不僅陷入恐怖幻覺,身體更逐漸異變,記..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amnesiac Marco awakens imprisoned in an abandoned house surrounded by corpses. Trapped inside, he is forced by a mysterious mastermind to play ten disturbing videos on a flash drive. As deadly curses unfold, he is plagued by terrifying visions while his body, memory and life slowly unravel. With the countdown to death underway, can he survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.programme_title_tc: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深主播艾米遭遇詭異蝙蝠襲擊後,帶著傷口返回電台,準備主持當晚的深夜節目。豈料竟遭無良老闆設局解僱,並被新人強行取代。適逢暴風雨封鎖整座電台,隨著傷口引發的異變愈演愈烈,艾米逐漸失控,在直播間掀起一場..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Radio host Amy is bitten by a mysterious bat, but she returns to the station to host that night’s late-night show. Instead, she is set up and fired by her ruthless boss, then replaced by a newcomer. As a violent storm traps everyone in the station and her mysterious wound worsens, Amy gradually loses control and unleashes a bloody massacre.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
民國年間,江南村落接連發生離奇命案,逐漸淪為遠近聞名的鬼村「封門村」。記者李穆與員警萬楓為追查一宗滅門慘案,深入陰森村莊抽絲剝繭,
誓要揭開連環命案背後的真相,破除流傳已久的封建迷信。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Republican era, a Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes the infamous ghost village of Fengmen. Journalist Li Mu and police officer Wan Feng venture into the eerie village to uncover the truth behind the killings and shatter the grip of superstition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靜雯是一名努力奮鬥的戲劇學生,為了應付學費開支而接受了一份模特兒的工作。然而,當她為一位專門從事表現性人體素描的神秘藝術家擔任模特兒時,靜雯意外地揭露了一個驚人真相,更將她推向生死邊緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家為了挽救低迷的事業,決心創作一部暢銷小說。他重返童年故居,這裡亦是其身為知名作家的父親當年神秘身亡之地。當他意外發現父親留下的最後手稿時,才驚覺這部作品遠超自己的才華。於是,他決定將..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 百毒派銳意製造武林不和,以實現稱霸江湖的野心。他們派出蒙面刺客殺戮另一門派,但其中一名刺客被捕後即被其他門派公審。最後審訊結果是什麼?最終又能否揭開真相?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they u

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武則天有傾國之貌,絕世才華,十四歲時更被唐太宗召為才人,但太宗死後卻入寺為尼,卻又與繼位之唐高宗有染,生有二子。時皇后與蕭妃爭寵,命武則天回宮以制妃子,卻反陷害皇后。武則天獲封皇后之後,更誅殺兩太子。直到高宗病亡,武后臨朝,成為史上第一個女皇帝。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大俠張七郎退隱江湖多年,他的妻兒及朋友卻被鬼頭黨所殺。悲憤的七郎打算獨力與鬼王決一生死,為他們報仇雪恨!惡名昭彰的鬼頭黨最終會被他打敗嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gang’s leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers’ claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching gove

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名強盜和一位居無定所的賭徒合作以賭賺錢。一天,他們成功從叛國軍閥屋裡偷取一大筆金錢,途中卻遇上革命戰士,並希望他們能資助革命叛軍計劃。二人是否會用偷來的財富協助革命戰士?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord’s home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄龍劇中為一準新郎,但卻遇上心術不正的恬妮單戀癡纏,更借助邪術降頭,務求奪取男方歡心。後恬妮裙下之臣羅烈及狄龍未婚妻,亦相繼加入戰團。一場因為愛而生與死的鬥爭,複雜的關係加上正邪大鬥法,將人性為達一己私慾的惡行,表露無遺。至於邪是否不能勝正?且看結局便有分曉。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述,警局偵緝部情侶探員鄭忠與王麗芬同往離島露營,半夜麗芬忽聞異聲,離營探看,突見綠光一閃,隨即著魔。翌日,王警官率眾處理一宗挾持人質案件,期間麗芬逕自開槍射殺劫匪,過程被雜誌記者阿古攝得,發現子彈竟能轉向殺人...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 據說諸魔化成的血鸚鵡,看見它的人能得到三個願望。江湖俠盜葉停楓為追尋血鸚鵡的真相;與名捕「鐵手無情」鐵恨聯手。某夜,葉、鐵二人在墳場遇上血鸚鵡,鐵死於它的魔力之下;後葉將其屍體送回家鄉安葬。其後,屍體卻離奇失蹤,葉經歷重重險阻後,終於見到真正的血鸚鵡…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個故事洋溢著《羅密歐與茱麗葉》般的悲戀色彩。兩個世代積怨已深的家族,被一條遍佈鱷魚的河流阻隔,誰也不願築橋往來。然而,命運卻讓兩家子女在大學裡邂逅並深深相愛。為了相守,他們不僅必須跨越險惡的河流,更要化解兩個家族間延續多年的仇恨。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一個耳熟能詳之中國民間神話故事,講述書生劉彥昌巧遇落入凡間的聖母三娘,二人一見鍾情,結下一段仙凡姻緣。但因與二郎神結怨,屢遭迫害,二郎神更將聖母壓在華山底下。彥昌與聖母之子沉香長大後,聞悉生母被壓華山,悲憤欲絕,藉神斧之助挫敗二郎神,劈山救母。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Lindas tragic suicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝兩位太子為要爭奪帝位,令人民死傷無數。被牽連在這場皇室鬥爭當中的女刺客,最終能否及時執行刺殺任務以助其中一位皇子登上皇位?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesnt care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dup

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo di

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandma’s pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chief’s daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

epg.programme_title_en: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 乾隆為體察民情,撇下侍衛假扮商人微服出訪江南,期間得知衙門有貪官欺壓百姓,導致民不聊生。這時乾隆遇上一名清廉的賣菜青年,二人合力教訓貪官一頓。最後,青年更被獲封為皇帝的近身侍衛。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more tha

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述張愛珠無意得知自己是孤兒,故往找生母。生母茱莉與流氓劉老四同居,老四心起歪念,竟欲非禮愛珠,茱莉救了女兒,卻被老四誤殺。愛珠逃回養父母家,始深深體會到養父母對她的愛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影承上集繼續笑料百出。這次,大蕃薯開了一家中醫診所,但傳統的中醫似乎不為時髦的香港社會接受。最後得靠好友老夫子相助,為他解決疑難!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一次驅鬼時,青年術士魯興與友人因功力太差被女鬼戲弄險告喪命,幸得連大師施法幫助,才將女鬼驅逐。於是二人馬上拜他為師。友人意外地被日本忍者所殺,魯興決定要學習絕世茅術,與大師一起對付殘暴的忍者,因而引發終極亂鬥!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of womens rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天下第一快刀傅紅雪為報父仇,萬里尋兇,途中七名兇手竟逐一離奇暴斃。傅紅雪與好友葉開追查真相,卻發現七人根本未死,一切皆是幕後主使「千面人魔」蕭別離操縱佈局,誘傅墮入圈套。葉開挺身相助,二人卻雙雙身陷刀陣,處境岌岌可危。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fu Hong Xue, a legendary swordsman, travels far to avenge his father, only to find the seven killers he tracks are already dead. Investigating with Yeh Kai, he learns they are alive, manipulated by disguise master Xiao Bie Li, who lures Fu into a tra

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漢高祖死後,呂后專權,密詔太尉設法殺死代王劉恆。幪面大俠發現其詭計後,馬上告知劉恆。劉於是急遣護衛保護公主往長安求援。太尉率大隊軍馬沿途追殺公主,幸得幪面大俠保護,處處化險為夷。最後,幪面大俠更助劉恆成功繼承漢室大統。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 碼頭工人林四海,一次助中央特派專員鄭志成脫險,因而得以加入警局;後告發要員收規,獲局長賞識,升為副官;繼而林藉局長三姨太欠下巨額賭債,唆使局長允其代受賄替三姨太還債;林辭去職務在黑道大展拳腳,復與碼頭總管事梅寶聯盟……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A docker, Lin Si Hai, accidentally saves Commissioner Cheng who then offers him a position in the police force. Lin is smart and soon rises through the ranks through treachery and corruption, before becoming a gangster.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comi

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is tak

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the government’s secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperor’s ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Sh

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部音樂喜劇講述青年貝小芬與好友漢堡飽在廣告界內尋找真愛和成就的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matt Damon returns as Jason Bourne in Jason Bourne, with director Paul Greengrass back for another thrilling chapter. Bourne is drawn out of hiding, facing new dangers with Alicia Vikander, Vincent Cassel, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Battleship, Earth battles a powerful alien force across sea, sky, and land. Directed by Peter Berg and starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, and Rihanna, its explosive action at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this suspenseful thriller, a high-priced and ruthless jury consultant will stop at nothing to secure a verdict on an explosive trial.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a gritty, plague-ridden 16th-century Europe, a cold-hearted band of mercenaries seek revenge on a noble lord who betrayed them by kidnapping his sons beautiful betrothed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《遺落戰境》中,湯姆・克魯斯飾演一名在未來地球踏上救贖之旅的男子。由《創:光速戰記》導演執導,這是一部視覺震撼、直面過去以拯救人類的科幻冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Oblivion*, Tom Cruise stars as a man on a journey of redemption in a future Earth. Directed by the creator of *TRON: Legacy*, it’s a visually stunning sci-fi adventure about confronting the past to save humanity.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two friends, ex Shaolin monks, part ways as they brush with the ongoing rebellion against the government. The ambitious one rises up to be a powerful military commander, while his betrayed friend resorts to learn the calm ways of Tai Chi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《恐怖角》中,勞勃・狄尼洛飾演一名心懷怨恨的前科犯,對其昔日律師(尼克・諾特飾)展開步步進逼的跟蹤報復。由馬丁・史柯西斯執導,這部充滿張力的驚悚片是令人不寒而慄的經典重拍之作。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Cape Fear, Robert De Niro plays a vengeful ex-con stalking his former lawyer, played by Nick Nolte. Directed by Martin Scorsese, this suspense-filled thriller is a chilling classic remake.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: With the nation of Panem in a full scale war, Katniss confronts President Snow in the final showdown.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一部風格獨特、跨越文化的義大利式西部片。講述一名法外之徒與一名冷酷的武士被迫在美國西南部聯手,追捕一名偷走欲獻給美國總統之無價禮儀寶劍的狡猾強盜首領。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A unique cross-cultural Spaghetti Western where an outlaw and a stoic samurai are forced to team up in the American Southwest to track down a smooth bandit leader who stole a priceless ceremonial sword intended for the US President.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 殺手與一名前陸軍特工,被捲入一名冷酷百萬富翁每年舉辦的荒島人獵遊戲,展開無情的生死追逐。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Killers and an ex-Army agent take part in a ruthless millionaire’s annual island manhunt.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當暴徒襲擊前刺客約翰·維克(基努·李維 飾)時,他們完全不知道自己招惹了一位黑道傳奇。維克將紐約市變成彈痕累累的戰場,展開一場毫不留情的追殺與復仇。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a gritty, plague-ridden 16th-century Europe, a cold-hearted band of mercenaries seek revenge on a noble lord who betrayed them by kidnapping his sons beautiful betrothed.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matt Damon returns as Jason Bourne in Jason Bourne, with director Paul Greengrass back for another thrilling chapter. Bourne is drawn out of hiding, facing new dangers with Alicia Vikander, Vincent Cassel, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The epic adventures of a man who discovers that he possesses the exhilarating ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world he can imagine.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A lazy but impossibly fast gunslinger named Trinity wanders into a dusty frontier town where his outlaw brother is masquerading as the local sheriff. Together, they reluctantly defend a group of peaceful Mormon farmers from a greedy cattle baron.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wanting to retire peacefully to Europe, an aging gunfighter is pursued by a young admirer named Nobody, who manipulates events so his hero goes out in a legendary blaze of glory against the 150-strong Wild Bunch gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 殺手與一名前陸軍特工,被捲入一名冷酷百萬富翁每年舉辦的荒島人獵遊戲,展開無情的生死追逐。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Killers and an ex-Army agent take part in a ruthless millionaire’s annual island manhunt.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位男子意外發現自己擁有驚人的超能力,能瞬間移動到世界上任何他能想像到的地方,就此展開一段史詩般的冒險之旅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The epic adventures of a man who discovers that he possesses the exhilarating ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world he can imagine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在這部緊張刺激的懸疑驚悚片中,一名身處法國南部的年輕女子出於正當防衛殺死了戴著面具的強暴犯,隨後卻發現自己遭到一名神秘的美國軍事調查官的激進審訊與跟蹤。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this tense thriller, a young woman in the South of France kills her masked rapist in self-defense, only to find herself aggressively interrogated and stalked by a mysterious American military investigator.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名懶散卻擁有驚人槍速的槍手「三一」(Trinity)出沒於一座塵土飛揚的邊境小鎮,發現自己身為逃犯的哥哥竟然在此冒充當地警長。兩人最終半推半共地聯手,保護一群和平的摩門教農夫免受貪婪畜牧大亨的欺壓。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A lazy but impossibly fast gunslinger named Trinity wanders into a dusty frontier town where his outlaw brother is masquerading as the local sheriff. Together, they reluctantly defend a group of peaceful Mormon farmers from a greedy cattle baron.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當一對亡命鴛鴦那段光鮮亮麗卻時而致命的冒險,演變成充滿背叛、死裡逃生、虛假身分以及令人頭昏眼花的愛情糾葛迷宮時,他們才終於意識到,此時此刻唯一能指望的,就只有彼此了。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When a fugitive couples glamorous and sometimes deadly adventure erupts into a maze of double-crosses, close escapes, false identities, and head-spinning romantic snafus, they come to realize that all they can count on is each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《遺落戰境》中,湯姆・克魯斯飾演一名在未來地球踏上救贖之旅的男子。由《創:光速戰記》導演執導,這是一部視覺震撼、直面過去以拯救人類的科幻冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Oblivion*, Tom Cruise stars as a man on a journey of redemption in a future Earth. Directed by the creator of *TRON: Legacy*, it’s a visually stunning sci-fi adventure about confronting the past to save humanity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 戰火多年讓藍波身心俱疲,但他終於在一座寺院中找到了內心的平靜。當好友兼導師特勞特曼上校請求他協助執行一項前往阿富汗的最高機密任務時,藍波予以拒絕;然而當特勞特曼遭到擄捕後,藍波不得不重新考慮。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Combat has taken its toll on Rambo, but he’s finally begun to find inner peace in a monastery. When Rambo’s friend and mentor Col. Trautman asks for his help on a top secret mission to Afghanistan, Rambo declines but must reconsider when Trautman is

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當重裝雇傭兵圍攻白宮,一名面試特勤局失敗的特警必須衝破封鎖線,奮力營救總統、拯救被扣為人質的女兒,並阻止第三次世界大戰爆發。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When heavily armed mercenaries siege the White House, a rejected Secret Service applicant must fight through the lockdown to save the President, rescue his hostage daughter, and prevent World War III.

Now they must con and fight their way across the west through thousands of cavalry, lawmen, bounty hunters, and Indians to make their escape.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In East Texas, the summer after high school, Jack falls in love with Ginny, the daughter of the town's banker (Jack's mom's high school sweetheart). Ginny's been at boarding school; she's headed for Vassar. Over her father's strenuous objections, she spends time with Jack. At summer's end, Jack and Ginny elope to Louisiana (where 17-year-olds can marry without their parents' permission), and he gets a job in the oil fields. Her dad hires a menacing private eye to find them, Ginny's pregnant, her town doctor gives her horrible news, and Jack's mom has her own agenda. It seems that Jack and Ginny have grown up under a liar's moon. What will these sweethearts do?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: France, 1640. The chivalrous Cyrano sets up with Christian an innocent deception, with tragic results.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a mission to extinguish the cross border gangs, Zhou Yang and Xiao Ke of the special task force witness the tragic death of their comrades and feel greatly disturbed and guilty. However, in a counterattack by the gangs, Zhou and Xiao team up again to fight against the gangs.  A final battle between the good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 霍元甲年少氣盛,認為武術為重。為了在天津的武館立足,他連續打敗了七家武館,在對戰大刀王五的徒弟幽蘭時,卻遭到朝廷勢力袁庭山的陷害。與此同時,霍負責護送維新首領譚先生回京城。在這次驚心動魄的任務中,他逐..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Huo Yuan Jia loves marital arts. He defeats seven martial arts school masters to establish himself in Tianjin, but is set up by a court official during a tournament. When Huo escorts a revolutionary leader to the capital, he finally understands that the country and its people are the ultimate purpose for practising martial arts.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緝毒精英的閆鵬在追捕毒販赤那時,同事兼好友阿古拉犧牲於毒販手中。之後鵬來到阿古拉家照顧他的家人,卻不料碰上真正的赤那到來,要阿古拉父親帶路,幫他逃離邊境。鵬隨後才知道,先前被他消滅的毒販竟然是赤那的孿..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agula, a friend and coworker of Narcotic agent Yan, is killed by the drug dealer Chi Na. While Yan takes care of Agulas family, he encounters Chi Na who wants to flee the country with the help of Agulas father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上陽郡主王萱在與寒族將軍蕭霽新婚之夜,為遵守與愛人三皇子子珩的約定,甘願飲毒酒假死,豈料這一切只是皇權氏族的陰謀算計。王萱傷透了心,為了報仇化身為吸食人血的修羅女,連子珩對她也非常懼怕。然而蕭霽卻對王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Princess Wang fakes death on her wedding day with General Xiao to fulfil her vow with her secret lover. After realizing it was a set up by the Emperor, Wang is devastated and turns into a blood demon to take revenge. However, General Xiao still stands by her side and helps her to uncover the truth behind an even bigger conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,生活在洛陽洛河水兩端但不同出生的兩個少女意外被捲入懸案之中。一位是金吾衛隊長的女兒趙青青,另一位是生於市井底層的女孩小騙子。她們一同遭遇在洛陽城內一連串匪夷所思的離奇案件,二人組成了臨時搭檔..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Zhou dynasty, two girls living in two ends of the Luo He River come from diverse backgrounds - one is a captains daughter and another is a common swindler - and they encounter a series of mysterious events in Luo Yang City. Both team up to investigate a series of bizarre cases, to uphold justice and to maintain order amidst a social upheaval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年的龍雲鎮,相傳鎮子發現寶藏後逐漸怪事不斷,接連出現少女家中被殺。同時,寶藏消息也招來各路心懷不軌的“江湖術士紛紛前來尋寶。巡捕隊的林隊長迫於鎮長壓力,決定聯手死刑犯計連營一起找出真凶及解開背..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of mysterious incidents happen when treasure is discovered in Long Yun Town, including killings of girls. As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛建成的洛陽宮夜裡被一條神龍縱火焚燒,木匠不是死就是失蹤。狄仁傑破格升任大理寺少卿查案,卻遭神秘勢力阻撓。他憑線索及隱士李先生的指點找到了關鍵人物宮少爺,也在紅顏知己柳月如協助下摧毀了機關基地。關鍵時..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The newly completed Luo Yang Palace is set to fire by the Fire Dragon, resulting in the carpenters being missing or dead. Detective Dee is tasked to investigate the case. He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特警大隊狙擊手張遠和觀察手胡兵在一次行動中,意外將人質李翔打傷致癱瘓。張之後離開特警大隊,與李成為搭檔。三年後,張根據一次調查線索潛入一家制毒工廠,卻發現前隊友胡是工廠負責人。與此同時,張剛巧碰上另一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: SWAT sniper Zhang and his spotter Hu accidentally paralyzed the hostage Li Xiang in an operation. Zhang left the team after and partnered with Li. Three years later, Zhang infiltrates a drug lab in an investigation, only to discover that it is operated by his former teammate Hu. When a drug gang raids the lab, Zhang is trapped in the fierce battle.

epg.programme_title_en: Fengshen the Fall of King Zhou
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女媧諸神啟動“封神計畫顛覆商朝統治,安排了九尾妖狐上身妲己前來迷惑紂王。而紂王日漸傾心妲己對她專寵無度,更不服神旨逆天而行,建摘星樓登天問道與神對抗,並受申公豹挑唆殘害忠良,百姓苦不堪言。姜子牙助四..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set by Goddess Nu Wa to overthrow the Shang dynasty, Consort Da Ji is possessed by the Demon Fox to bewitch Emperor Zhou. Zhou spoils Da Ji by building a tower to heaven against Gods will, and even oppresses his people. Jiang Zi Ya steps up to help fight the Emperor, starting a war between the humans, the gods and the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上古時期,魔族首領蚩尤擾亂天庭,最終被打回原形,天尊把他貶為凡人,及賜給他仁慈的心。數年後,蚩尤體內的魔性被別有用心的人喚醒,他便前往昆侖尋求解封方法。蚩尤途中結識了火焰山公主葉瀟瀟,二人情愫漸生,而..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in ancient times, leader of the demon tribe, Chi You, causes chaos in heaven and is demoted to become a kind human. When Chi Yous evil power awakens years later, he find ways to break his seal in Kun Lun, where he meets a princess and fall in love. Through perilous trials, Chi You and the princess unravel the truth behind a conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明德市郊外發生了一宗拋屍命案,公安局副局長楊棟帶領整個警隊展開深入調查。他們逐步揭開了以企業家林峰為首的頂峰集團涉嫌殺人、放高利貸、及開設賭場等罪行。隨著對掃除黑勢力專案的持續進行,那些無惡不作的犯罪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A police deputy chief leads an investigation about a body discovered in Ming De Town, and gradually unveils a series of crimes, including murder, loan sharking and casino activities by a company owned by entrepreneur Lin Feng. The police go all out to fight vigorously against the criminals as anti-triad operations continue...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海市發生連續殺人案,幻術師羅賓協助警員龍聰調查。兩人發現死者大多是隱姓埋名的幻術師,羅賓推測兇手殺人的目的是為了寶藏,卻發現真兇美智子利用暗黑幻術殺人。最後美智子用幻術召喚出玄冰白虎,而羅..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Robin assists a police officer to investigate a serial murder. While they discover that most victims are incognito illusionists, Robin thinks that the murderer kills for a treasure, and later identifies Mei as the culprit who uses dark illusions to kill. Mei summons White Tiger to fight against the Fire Dragon commanded by Robin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國女學生林家英親眼目睹姐姐被軍閥馬世傑迫害致死而卻無能為力,並在隨後趕到的何美梓口中得知姐姐原來是秘密特工隊“魅影的一員。為替姐姐報仇,英加入魅影特工隊,接受訓練成為一名美豔特工。在一次執行任務中..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young student Ying helplessly witness her sister being persecuted to death by a warlord. When she realizes her sister is a member of the secret agency Phantom, Ying vows to avenge her death and joins Phantom. She eventually becomes a pretty secret agent but soon unveils the secret behind Phantom during a mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長安大理寺捕快郝龍霄神功蓋世,卻為救被妖獸傷害的妹妹,被幻獸妖魔之王鬼車所利用,得奪取各樣法器來助鬼車開啟陣法。原來鬼車的目的是吸聚百姓精血,顛覆人類,以幻獸來控制世界。幸而郝識破鬼車的陰謀,在危急關..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his sister, top martial artist Constable Xie is forced by the Monster King to find all magical weapons for a tactical plot. The Monster Kings real purpose is to suck peoples blood and control the world through eudemon. Knowing his evil plan, Constable Xie decides to unlock his hidden power and begins a fierce battle with Monster King.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 香港警隊與黑勢力誓不兩立,一個以程志飛為隊長的“反飛車組組成反飆車隊,另一個以蔣小海為首的“飛車黨是一群黑市非法街頭飆車黨。因為一局地下飆車賽,警方在調查過程中顯露了程與蔣長達十五年的恩怨,更揭開..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hong Kong Police and the triads are irreconcilable opponents. Inspector Cheng leads the anti street car racing team and Jiang is the leader of the street car racing gang. While the police investigates an underground street car race, they uncover the 15-year grudge between Cheng and Jiang, and discover a hidden triad group.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十年前,身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假,不料突發遇到颱風,張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質,妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭,不料又一場颱風來襲,妻子被颱風所困,女兒又被人綁架。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 10 years ago, rescue team leader Zhang suffered the loss of his son in a landslide during a typhoon. His anguish leads to his wifes request for divorce. While Zhang tries to reconcile with his family, another typhoon strikes. His wife is trapped and their daughter is kidnapped. Facing such difficulties, Zhang must save his wife and daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球太空基地捕捉到一組來自外太空的神秘訊號,為探尋外星文明,艦長“原帶領船員駕駛著星際探索飛船“深空號駛向宇宙,但不久飛船卻神秘失蹤。150年後,深空號突然出現,船上只剩下一名女科學家“尹。在她..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Yuan and his crew explore the mysteries of outer space after the Space Centre detects extraterrestrial signals. However, the spacecraft vanishes after lift-off. 150 years later, the spacecraft reappears, harbouring a female scientist. The secret of outer space is unveiled through her recollection of the crew’s peculiar experience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 利欲熏心的地產商為了開發蛇王島,重金收買以金老四為首的黑市捕蛇團夥,企圖登島滅蛇。與此同時,身為養蛇家族後人的陳崢與動物保護專家周曉曉及馬奮,為了印證泰坦巨蟒存在的傳說,亦到島上搜集資料。陳崢等人為了..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A greedy property developer bribes a snake catcher gang to eradicate serpents on King Serpent Island for profit. Meanwhile, the snake clans descendant and two animal protection experts venture to the island to confirm the existence of the legendary Titan Snake, resulting in a fierce battle with the ruthless gang to preserve the islands ecology.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 利欲熏心的地產商為了開發蛇王島,重金收買以金老四為首的黑市捕蛇團夥,企圖登島滅蛇。與此同時,身為養蛇家族後人的陳崢與動物保護專家周曉曉及馬奮,為了印證泰坦巨蟒存在的傳說,亦到島上搜集資料。陳崢等人為了..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A greedy property developer bribes a snake catcher gang to eradicate serpents on King Serpent Island for profit. Meanwhile, the snake clans descendant and two animal protection experts venture to the island to confirm the existence of the legendary Titan Snake, resulting in a fierce battle with the ruthless gang to preserve the islands ecology.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了取長補短,陳真遠赴日本學習工業技術。留學期間,陳真與擅長形意拳的武術家薛自立一起,為了捍衛中國人民的尊嚴,他們勇敢面對日本軍部官員的比武挑戰。一場中國功夫大師與日本武士的較量正式上演,比武場上陳真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen travels to Japan to learn industrial technology, he teams up with martial artist She Zi Li, and accepts a duel challenge from the Japanese military officials to uphold the Chinese dignity. In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1928年的上海灘,新生勢力龍德商會為擴大地盤與老牌勢力通明堂產生利益衝突,雙方摩擦不斷。通明堂小少爺周放,因父親被殺要為父報仇,帶領眾人對決龍德商會,卻在復仇過程中與商會二把手林海惺惺相惜。然而二人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1928 Shanghai, a new triad gang plans to expand their territory, causing conflicts with the old triad gang. As the son of the old triad boss seeks revenge for his fathers death, he accidentally makes friend with the new triad boss right-hand man. However, as the two are destined rivals, a fatal battle between them is inevitable!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盛世大唐氣象萬千,各色人物皆在江湖中行走,身懷絕技的盲眼“捉刀人成瞎子,遇上慘遭滅門和淩辱的酒家女倪燕。原本不與人有過多交情的成瞎子卻意外與她產生關聯,亦逐漸被捲入一場勢力龐大的暗黑紛爭中。成瞎子開..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talents are found everywhere in the Tang dynasty, including Blind man Cheng. He meets a barmaid Ni Yan, who has lost her family and gotten abused, and they become friends. This entangles Cheng into a big triad conflict, and as he starts his journey of revenge, his true identity is also revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏年間,新君登基,時局未穩,遊牧民族柔然對魏國虎視眈眈。為牽制柔然,大魏公主和親北涼,不料卻被柔然猛將綿爾圖擄走。綿挾持公主,要魏國在兩日內交出十座城池為贖金。魏國將軍花木蘭臨危受命,更啟用死囚慕容..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Northern Wei empire faces raids from the nomadic Rou Ran tribe. The princess of Wei is kidnapped by a Rou Ran general, who demands ten cities as ransom. Weis General Mulan forms a special task force to rescue the princess and a fatal battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一列載著淘金夢開往上海的列車突然脫軌墜崖。吳天等一行人倖免於難,卻遭到蜈蚣攻擊。隨後他們逃進了一個怪異村莊,而古怪的村長對這幫各懷鬼胎的倖存者起了殺心。突然成群蜈蚣傾巢而出,在村中大開殺戒。吳天等..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A train carrying gold rushers derails and falls off the cliff. Wu and other passengers survive, but are attacked by centipedes. Subsequently, they escape to a village. With the village head trying to kill them and the centipedes attacking at the same time, can Wu and other passengers escape the disaster? What is the secret of the village head?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少男曾為獲得格鬥冠軍的哥哥少北為驕傲,以為有哥哥在便能永遠保護自己,可以像少年時一樣無憂無慮。最終哥哥在衝刺世界格鬥冠軍擂臺上身受重傷意外身亡。格鬥公司創辦人丹姐訓練少男幫助他復仇,而少男亦替少北贏回..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shao Nan is proud of his brother Shao Bai being the combat fighting champion. When Shao Bei died after being seriously injured in a fight, the founder of the fight company decides to train Shao Nan for vengeance. Shao Nan eventually rises to become the next champion, fulfilling his brothers last wish and make Asians proud.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武狀元蘇燦在打擊販賣大煙的天門教鬥爭中意外受傷失憶,流落街頭淪為蘇乞兒,及後被金枝和小果母女收留。小果意外發現了配製好的鴉片膏,被天門教捉走。蘇乞兒為了救小果及避免鴉片禍害百姓,一舉破壞了天門教的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Top martial artist Su Can lost his memory in a battle with the opium seller, Tian Men Cult. He becomes a beggar and is taken in by a mother and her daughter. The daughter is caught by the cult when she accidentally discovers the opium. Beggar Su joins the court to save the girl and destroy the cult, so as to stop the opiums harm on people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期上海,怪物獵人宇文預測到上豪大飯店有怪獸出現,而當怪獸現身襲擊表演的花旦顧青時,宇文英雄救美,打斷富少警探天明的公開表白。之後三人被捲入了一系列的奇怪案件,在調查過程中,所有線索都指向一個塵封..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican time in Shanghai, monster hunter Yu saves an actress in a play from a monsters attack, at the same time interrupting a cops love confession for her. As the trio gets involved in a series of mysterious cases, they find out that the cases are related to a legend about a giant monster who will soon be returning to the world...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天意是天界出名的留級生,因前世孽緣未了無法成仙,後來一次意外他無意釋放了雪女令她越獄下凡,在捉拿雪女過程中,天意發現自己竟是害她淪為雪妖的人。為了彌補過錯,天意自願在陰間路上漂泊千年,一番磨難後,二人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tian Yi is destined to fail as an immortal in heaven. When he accidentally frees Snowy and makes her a demon, he wanders in hell for thousand years to right his wrong. After a series of hardships, Snowy and Tian Yi manages to get married, but the heavenly warriors attempt to arrest Snowy. Can the couple live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漫畫展上,宅男漫畫家郝萍穹意外與殺手肖白菜交換了身體。穹由廢柴變成擁有豐滿身材和超能力的少女,但他卻不斷被壞人追殺。白菜不用擔心受敵人襲擊,但她卻每天過著被追稿的生活。這換位人生讓他們更了解自己的能力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bottom-ranking cartoonist Hao and killer Xiao accidentally swapped identities at a comic fair. Hao becomes a powerful girl but is pursued by villains, while Xiao is free from pursuit but must work on deadlines everyday. After knowing their capabilites and responsibilities, they resume their identities and team up to fight the villains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,日本特務吉岡意圖找到龍棺裡的徐福寶藏,便命人僱傭探險家陳啟龍尋找一本神秘的竹簡。陳在一座古墓中找到竹簡,及後得知是交給日本人,便搶回竹簡和傭金。根據竹簡上的指引,陳與夥伴們踏上蓬萊仙島尋找寶..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Japanese agent commissions Chinese explorer Chen to locate a bamboo note leading to Xu Fu’s treasure. Chen finds the note but refuses to give it to the Japanese, keeping both the note and his pay. As Chen and his friends follow the instructions to an island where the treasure is concealed, they are unaware that a mysterious pursuit is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗倭寇志士追馬流落到邊境沙漠之地,選擇在這裡開一家客棧來度過餘生。一天,仇人之女白鹿攜寶箱逃命到客棧,追馬本可有機會把她除掉,然而白鹿要將寶箱中可以對抗倭寇的機密平安送出。追馬為了民族大義,最終放棄仇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeking a tranquil existence, anti-Japanese patriot Zhui operates an inn on the outskirts of town. The daughter of his foe flees to his inn one day with a treasure box containing the secret to fight the Japanese bandits. Though Zhui can easily kill her, he sets aside his hatred aside to help Bai fight back and deliver the secret box safely.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河北省的秋風縣在半個月前寡婦何秀琴在城外被匪徒殺害後,縣城一座名叫赤橋的橋上開始出現「女鬼」。縣太爺陳之章命令捕快郭幻率領眾人限期捉鬼,當郭抓住了裝鬼大漢夏蟲,得知夏裝鬼的理由,才發現原來背後竟藏著一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female ghost is sighted at a bridge following the murder of a widow two weeks ago in Qiu Feng County. Inspector Guo is assigned to hunt down the ghost promptly. Upon investigation, Guo discovers a man named Xia Chong disguising himself as the female ghost, leading to the revelation of a peculiar murder case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在辛亥革命軍閥混戰的民國時期,用幻術蠱惑人心的教派林立,以無量老祖為首的教派常用幻術騙局荼毒百姓。這時大家閨秀孫瑾、人狼鏢師黎叔文、及征戰沙場多年的功夫奇才楊烈鈞,三人一起誓要揭露所有幻術的真相。但他..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, many sects use sleazy scams to deceive the public. Young maiden Sun Jin, armed escort Li, and the kung fu expert Yang, join forces to uncover the truth behind the widespread deception. However, they soon discover the hidden secrets of Yang and Li. Who amongst them is the true villain?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人族和妖族長年爭鬥,人族首領黃帝得奇門遁甲的力量終於平定世界,之後成立霧隱門來保護百姓。羅剎鎮捕頭周同因為被死對頭追殺,逃難途中隅遇生命垂危的霧隱門天老。關鍵時刻天老將體內武功傳給了周同,及後在霧..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武則天時期,京城長安接連發生了好幾次離奇死亡案件,因為死因不明,以致忠烈祠飛天壁畫顯靈殺人的謠言愈演愈烈,百姓紛紛認為是天降不祥,人心惶惶。在地方屢破奇案的狄仁傑奉命調查此案,最終不僅破除了謠言,也通..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the era of Empress Wu, rumours about mysterious murder cases are spreading in Chang An City. The people are worried and see it as an ominous sign. Detective Di is assigned to investigate the case, and not only did he manage to unravel the mystery, he also uncovers the truth and finds the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來世界,人工智慧高速發展,由程非掌控的地下科研組織,為牟取暴利研製激發異能人的晶片。由於一次變故,程下令清除所有實驗者,導致千鶴母親犧牲,而逃出生天的千鶴為替母親報仇,以身涉險對抗惡勢力,在危急關頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an AI-driven world, the underground institute has developed chips which can activate supernatural power for profiteering. An accident occurs and killed Qian Hes mother. Qian He vows to avenge her mothers death and fight against the villains after provoking her supernatural power, finally unveiling the institutes hidden secret.
